import sys


def main() -> None:
    raw = sys.stdin.read()
    tokens = raw.split()
    a = int(tokens[0])
    b = int(tokens[1])
    m = int(tokens[2])
    r = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b % 2 == 1:
            r = r * a % m
        a = a * a % m
        b //= 2
    print(r)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
alt: The program computes a to the power b, keeping only the remainder after dividing by m. It reads the binary digits of b from the lowest upward. When a digit is 1 the current a is multiplied into the result r, and every round a is squared and b is halved, so the loop runs once per binary digit of b.
